basic_details.job_title: HP Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Para Cook, Para Helper Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited for 2 posts of Para Cook (1 vacancy) and Para Helper (1 vacancy) on an honorarium basis for the operation and upkeep of Rest Houses and Inspection Huts at the Office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Reckong Peo, Distt. Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh, with completed applications on the prescribed proforma to reach the office on or before 07 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

selection_process: Percentage of marks obtained to be calculated out of 5 (for example getting 50% marks in 10th will be given 2.5 (Two and Half)) 5 Marks
BPL Family having annual income as prescribed from time to time 1 Marks
Skill test for Para Cook & Para Helper 2 Marks
The selection will be purely on Merit basis. In the selection process marks will be awarded to the candidates out of 10 marks by the selection committee:

The date for the skill test of eligible candidates will be intimated separately after scrutiny of documents papers by the selection committee and No TA/DA will be payable to the applicants for appearing in the skill test.
important_instructions: The selected incumbent will be paid honorarium at the rate of Rs. 9000/- per month for Para Cook and 5500/- per month for Para Helper. These posts will remain honorarium based and will not form part of cadre post of the department and therefore, will not confer any right on the appointees to claim regularization as per current policy of the Government. The working hours of incumbents shall be 6 hours per day. Unsatisfactory performance may result in termination of appointment by passing an order. The process of termination shall however not be completed unless at least 3 notices have been served upon the incumbent on a specific charge and there has been no improvement in service delivery, the concerned J.E would have substantially put down in written the reasons for such termination and this need to be countersigned by concerned Assistant Engineer based on record. A quarterly self reporting format (to be devised by the Jal Shakti Vibhag) would be filled by the Para Cook and Para Helper and submitted to the Junior Engineer concerned. Based on this at the end of every financial year, a consolidated report would be placed (on a format to be devised by the Jal Shakti Vibhag) for the community certification of satisfactory work and conduct. This certificate shall be electronically sent to the concerned Superintending Engineer for the record. The applications received after the due date or found incomplete will be rejected straight away without assigning any reason. The department will not be responsible for delay in receipt of application due to any reason.

content_sections.heading: HP Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The notice does not mention any application fee. Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag is the state government department responsible for drinking water, irrigation, and related infrastructure across Himachal Pradesh. Under this recruitment process, the Jal Shakti Division Reckong Peo in District Kinnaur engages local personnel for the upkeep and operation of departmental Rest Houses and Inspection Huts in line with the department's Para Policy.

rows.details: Rs. 9,000/- per month (Para Cook); Rs. 5,500/- per month (Para Helper)
Matriculation with Diploma/Degree or 5 years experience for Para Cook; Matriculation for Para Helper
Jal Shakti Circle, Reckong Peo, Distt. Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed application forms on the prescribed proforma, along with all requisite self-attested documents, must be submitted either in person or by post to the following address on or before 07 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM: Office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Reckong Peo, Distt. Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh The prescribed application proforma can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer on any working day or downloaded from the official departmental website (https://jsv.hp.nic.in/). Applications received after the deadline or found incomplete will be rejected straight away without assigning any reason. The department will not be responsible for delay in receipt of application due to any reason. Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application form for each post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Must be a citizen of India. Must be a Bonafide Himachali. Must possess a sound mind. No family member of the candidate should be employed in any kind of Government, PSU, or Board job. Must have never been involved in any act of a criminal nature. Must be medically fit to perform duties. Must be a permanent resident of the area under Jal Shakti Circle, Reckong Peo, Distt. Kinnaur (HP). Age Limit: 18 to 45 years. Para Cook: The candidate should have passed the matriculation examination from a School/Institution situated within Himachal Pradesh (the condition of passing 10th from a Himachali School shall not be applicable to Bonafide Himachali). In addition, the candidate must possess a degree/diploma in any trade from a Government-approved Hotel Management Institute/Institute of Hotel Management or Food Production Institute, OR a minimum of 5 (five) years of experience in Cooking/catering from any Government or private institution. Para Helper: The candidate should have passed the matriculation examination from the Board/University recognized by the H.P./Central Government (the condition of passing 10th from a Himachali School shall not be applicable to Bonafide Himachali). content_sections.heading: HP Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Operation and upkeep of Rest Houses/Inspection Huts on Honorarium basis as per norms fixed in the Para Policy of Jal Shakti Vibhag. All works assigned to him/her relating to their respective field(s). Any other duties assigned by the officers/official concerned. The working hours of incumbents shall be 6 hours per day.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of the following documents along with the application form: Matriculation certificate showing details marks obtained (in case the candidate does not submit detailed mark sheet, his/her application will be rejected). Degree/Diploma in any trade from Government approved Hotel Management Institute/Institute of Hotel Management or Food Production Institute or minimum 5(five) years experience in cooking/catering from any Government or private institution (applicable to Para Cook only). Bonafide Himachali certificate. Non Employment Certificate regarding no family member of the candidate is employed in any kind of Government/PSU/Board Job. Valid Character Certificate issued by the 1st class Magistrate. BPL Certificate issued not later than six months (if any). Experience Certificate in the related field (if any). SC/ST/OBC/EWS Certificate issued by competent authority as per HP Government time to time notification. Medical fitness Certificate. Having never been involved in any act of criminal nature.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in HP Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies in total, consisting of 1 post for Para Cook (UR) and 1 post for Para Helper (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form must reach the office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Reckong Peo on or before 07 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Para Cook?
faq.answer: The candidate should have passed matriculation examination from a School/Institution situated within Himachal Pradesh (not applicable to Bonafide Himachali) and must possess a degree/diploma in any trade from a Government-approved Hotel Management Institute/Institute of Hotel Management or Food Production Institute, or a minimum of 5 years of experience in Cooking/catering from any Government or private institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Para Helper?
faq.answer: The candidate should have passed matriculation examination from the Board/University recognized by the H.P./Central Government (the condition of passing 10th from a Himachali School shall not be applicable to Bonafide Himachali).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Para Cook and Para Helper posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 45 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly honorarium for these posts?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs. 9,000/- per month for Para Cook and Rs. 5,500/- per month for Para Helper.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is purely on merit basis out of 10 marks: percentage of marks in 10th (5 marks), BPL family status (1 mark), experience in related field (2 marks), and skill test (2 marks).

faq.question: Q8. Is this recruitment permanent or honorarium-based?
faq.answer: These positions are strictly honorarium-based under the Para Policy of Jal Shakti Vibhag and will not form part of the cadre post of the department nor confer any right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Can an applicant apply for both posts?
faq.answer: If a candidate wants to apply for more than one post, a separate application for each post needs to be submitted.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply in terms of residential status?
faq.answer: Applicants must be Bonafide Himachalis and permanent residents of the area under Jal Shakti Circle, Reckong Peo, Distt. Kinnaur (HP).
